period: 2014-present (re-elected for a third term in April 2026)
detail: President of Nantes Métropole, the metropolitan public authority (établissement public de coopération intercommunale). She has chaired it since April 2014 and was re-elected in 2020 and again in April 2026. This presidency is the basis for most of the ex officio seats she holds in affiliated public bodies, local public companies (SPL) and semi-public companies (SEM).
Mayor of Nantes since April 2014, the first woman to hold the office. The mayoral mandate is the source of further ex officio representation in local bodies and companies.

entity: SAMOA - Société d'Aménagement de la Métropole Ouest Atlantique
ownership_stake: n/a (local public development company - SPL; seat held ex officio)
detail: President of SAMOA, the public development company responsible for the Île de Nantes urban renewal project and the Quartier de la Création. Seat held ex officio as President of Nantes Métropole, as recorded in her HATVP declaration of interests and confirmed by SAMOA governance pages.
